note: Independent observations/summaries; not reproduced full standards or legal advice.

rules.title: NGA Factors not the statutory NGER measurement instrument
rules.applies_to: General emissions estimation vs regulated NGER distinction
rules.finding: The NGA workbook should not be used in place of the NGER Measurement Determination for statutory NGER reports.

rules.title: Recycled First materials optimisation
rules.applies_to: Eligible VIDA and SRLA projects; contracts govern project-specific applicability
rules.finding: Relevant bidders must demonstrate optimisation of recycled/reused Victorian material within approved specifications; tender plan and reporting requirements may apply.

rules.title: Recycled First plan at tender and delivery
rules.finding: A Recycled First Plan and reporting of recycled/reused material commitments are required in relevant tenders.

rules.title: General Environmental Duty
rules.applies_to: Activities producing pollution or waste risks in Victoria
rules.finding: Take reasonably practicable steps to eliminate or reduce risks of harm to health and environment from pollution or waste.

rules.title: NGER threshold applicability
rules.applies_to: Corporate groups and facilities meeting statutory conditions
rules.finding: Thresholds: facilities 25,000 t CO2e scope 1+2 or 100 TJ production/consumption; corporate groups 50,000 t CO2e scope 1+2 or 200 TJ production/consumption, subject to statutory definitions.

rules.title: Reader Room use restrictions
rules.applies_to: Access and reuse of Australian Standards
rules.finding: Free Reader Room is limited to personal non-commercial view-only access; download, reproduction and embedding in distributed agent are prohibited absent permission.
